standard.summary: 指定参与训练的 GPU 编号，多卡用逗号分隔（如 0,1）；此处只接受数字编号。留空时继承 launcher 启动时选择的显卡。
standard.effect: 填了就只在这些卡上排队与启动；留空则先看 launcher 设置里的 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES，两者都空时由队列从全部可见卡里按显存容量挑。
standard.whenToUse: 单机多卡、要把某张卡留给出图或别的训练时填。只想沿用启动时选的卡就留空。
standard.avoidWhen: 编号在本机不存在时任务会被直接判为 unsatisfiable 并拒绝，不会静默回落到别的卡；换机器/插拔显卡后要复核这里。GPU-<uuid> 这类稳定选择器此处不接受，要用 launcher 的 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES。

standard_en.summary: The GPU indices that take part in training, comma-separated for several cards (0,1); only numeric indices are accepted here. Left blank, it inherits the cards selected when the launcher started.
standard_en.effect: Filled in, queueing and launch happen on those cards only; left blank, the launcher's CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES setting applies, and with both empty the queue picks from all visible cards by VRAM capacity.
standard_en.whenToUse: Fill it in on a multi-GPU machine when you want to keep a card free for image generation or another run. Leave it blank to stay with the cards chosen at launch.
standard_en.avoidWhen: An index that does not exist on this machine makes the job unsatisfiable and it is refused outright, never quietly moved to another card -- re-check this after changing machines or moving cards. Stable selectors like GPU-<uuid> are not accepted here; use the launcher's CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES for those.

advanced.principle: gpu_ids 与 cuda_visible_devices 是两级：前者是训练参数级的设备选择，后者是进程级的可见性。decide_queue_gpu_group 先读 gpu_ids，为空才读 cuda_visible_devices —— 所以两个都填时 gpu_ids 赢，继承逻辑也因此在任一字段非空时整体让位，避免一个决定被两个字段编码。
advanced.intervention: 留空 + launcher 里选好卡，是推荐的默认用法：一处选择同时管住 launcher 自己的训练页和 WebUI 提交的任务。要在单次任务里临时换卡再填这里。
advanced.expectedImpact: 只影响设备选择与排队可行性；world size 仍由已解析的分布式进程/机器配置决定（见 training_step_breakdown 的假设说明）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 填死编号可复现但不跟随硬件变化；留空跟随 launcher 但需要记得 launcher 当前选了什么。
advanced.codePath: core/services/training_request_adapter.py:apply_launcher_gpu_default（留空时的继承）→ core/services/training_queue_gpu_group.py:_requested_indices（两级读取顺序、UUID 选择器容许范围）→ training_queue_control.py（把选中的编号写回 cuda_visible_devices）→ training_queue_support.py:build_worker_env（落成子进程的 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES）

advanced_en.principle: gpu_ids and cuda_visible_devices are two tiers: the former is training-parameter-level device selection, the latter is process-level visibility. decide_queue_gpu_group reads gpu_ids first and only falls back to cuda_visible_devices when it is empty — so when both are set gpu_ids wins, and the inheritance logic therefore stands down entirely whenever either field is non-empty, keeping one decision from being encoded by two fields.
advanced_en.intervention: Leave empty and pick the GPU in the launcher — the recommended default: one choice governs both the launcher's own training page and tasks submitted from the WebUI. Fill this in only to swap GPUs for a single task.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Affects device selection and queue feasibility only; world size is still decided by the resolved distributed process/machine configuration (see the assumptions note in training_step_breakdown).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Hard-coding indices is reproducible but does not follow hardware changes; leaving it empty follows the launcher but requires remembering what the launcher currently has selected.
advanced_en.codePath: core/services/training_request_adapter.py:apply_launcher_gpu_default (inheritance when empty) → core/services/training_queue_gpu_group.py:_requested_indices (two-tier read order, UUID selector allowance) → training_queue_control.py (writes the selected indices back to cuda_visible_devices) → training_queue_support.py:build_worker_env (lands as the child process's CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES)
